messages:
leo_cs: Quick weekly reserved-pool pulse for Reservoir. GPU hours: 6,100 this week (+12% w/w). Baseline fine but we saw a concentrated burst Thu 03:22 with saturation at 93% and queue depth hit 18.
anya_ops: Oof. Was that onboarding traffic or a production sweep?
leo_cs: Looks like a tenant, Nimble, ramped a hyperparameter sweep + model warmup jobs during their onboarding window. They hit concurrency knobs too high.
derek_sre: Any error spike / higher p95 during the window?
leo_cs: Yes 1.  p95 went from ~380ms to ~1.1s for ~45 minutes. Error rate 1.4% (mostly 5xx internal). No SLA breach but user-facing slowdowns.
autoscale-bot: autoscale event: vertical scale attempt failed at 03:25Z due to quota limit.
tim_prod: We throttled Nimbles ingest at 03:30 and applied a temporary tenant-concurrency cap (6). Queue cleared in ~20m.
derek_sre: I'll create a short-term mitigation: automatic tenant cap if single-tenant saturation >70% for 20m. Will post the rule before EOD.
leo_cs: Customer outreach: Nimble notified, they agreed to stagger experiments and accept a short enablement call.
anya_ops: Renewal impact? They just signed reserved hours last quarter. Could this push them to request a downgrade?
leo_cs: Risk is low but they expressed desire for clearer onboarding guidelines and a recommended sweep schedule. Recommend an enablement session + a template job schedule to avoid bursts.
tim_prod: Action items: 1) derek_sre add pool guard rule (owner: derek_sre). 2) leo_cs schedule 30-min enablement with Nimble and share job-template (owner: leo_cs). 3) anya_ops draft short onboarding doc note for reserved customers (owner: anya_ops). Due: Wed next week.
derek_sre: I'll also add a metric alert: notify #eng-oncall + #customer-success if p95 > 700ms or queue > 12 for 10m.
autoscale-bot: config: temporary-tenant-cap enabled for reservoir at 2026-03-24T04:10Z.
leo_cs: Quick cost note for customer: if they stagger sweeps it reduces peak GPU-hours by ~9% -> ~550 GPU-hours/month saved (~$16k/mo estimate). I'll include in follow-up.
leo_cs: TL;DR: Reservoir pool healthy overall, isolated tenant-driven burst caused queueing & latency bump, mitigations applied, enablement scheduled. Owners: derek_sre, leo_cs, anya_ops. No SLA breach. :white_check_mark:
